name: musicflow-downloader
description: MusicFlow Downloader — Análise de links Spotify/YouTube, organização de faixas e conversão autorizada para MP3 com FFmpeg.

scripts.build: npm --workspace=@musicflow/shared run build && npm --workspace=@musicflow/worker run build && npm --workspace=@musicflow/web run build
scripts.test: npm --workspace=@musicflow/shared test && npm --workspace=@musicflow/worker test && npm --workspace=@musicflow/web test
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace=@musicflow/shared run build && npm --workspace=@musicflow/shared run typecheck && npm --workspace=@musicflow/worker run typecheck && npm --workspace=@musicflow/web run typecheck
